title: Incident review: scheduler outage
scratchpad:
root cause: expired cert on job queue
weekly on-call starting Mon
segments: Let's do the review for Wednesday's outage. Odette, walk us through the timeline.
The scheduler stopped dispatching jobs on September thirtieth at two fourteen in the afternoon.
It was down for forty seven minutes. We restored service at three oh one.
An expired TLS certificate on the job queue. The workers couldn't connect, so nothing got picked up.
About three hundred jobs were delayed. Nothing was lost, they all ran after the fix.
Harrowgate opened a ticket, and two smaller accounts emailed support.
Harrowgate is in the middle of a renewal, so I'll mention it to Elena.
For action items, I want expiry alerts on every certificate we own.
I'll set them up to fire thirty days before expiry.
Alerts are good, but renewal should be automatic. Nobody should renew a cert by hand.
I'll move every certificate to automated renewal by October sixteenth.
I'll write the status page post today and send it to Maya for review.
Thanks. The other problem is nobody was clearly on call.
From now on we run a weekly on-call rotation, starting next Monday.
Agreed. I'll put the schedule in the team calendar.

items.text: Scheduler outage on September 30 lasted 47 minutes
Weekly on-call rotation starting next Monday
Add certificate expiry alerts that fire 30 days ahead
Move every certificate to automated renewal by October 16
Write the status page post and send it for review
Put the on-call schedule in the team calendar
Tell Elena that Harrowgate was affected by the outage
